notes.title: Finally announcing the rebranding...
notes.content:
[img]https://starbitlight.com/posts/about-nightlight-secrets-progress-img/nls-characters.jpg[/img]


[h2]A new name, a new start.[/h2]

Since this game's first early access release on Steam in November 2021, we knew that the game's name would be a problem for reaching various players from all the ages and that the only people who could play might need to be adult.

The game's name wasn't the only problem too: at first, the story planned was much 'edgy and darker' too, so in any case just changing the game's name would not change the game's rating at all.

After thinking for a while, we revisited many aspects of the game's story. Same characters, same environments, and almost same story.


[h2]Suspending the early access updates[/h2]

Like said in a 2 years old post, we feel like releasing the game in Early Access and wanting to release frequent updates to add more acts was a complete mistake, especially for a game project that is being worked on free-time. This game is mainly supposed to be a story based game, where you follow the protagonist's life, complete various missions, travel through dreams and nightmares, and make strong decisions.

We can't wait to show you the impressive work we did over the past years on the full game. There's so much new stuff, new characters, new twists, new environments, and new music too!

The plan for the game is that we will keep working on it like we were doing for the past years, and we will release the full and final version of the game along side the rebranding on Steam whenever we are done with everything missing.


[h2]Why does it take so long?[/h2]

Starbit Light is a small team of people who are passionate into game development. We are working together on projects, but not all the time because we do this in our free time.
Starbit Light isn't a video game company, this means that the projects we are working on are not our job and we are not earning anything from it for now.
We work on the projects beside having a life, and a job too (that isn't developing games).


[h1]The rebranding[/h1]

We are really happy to finally announce that "SFH" is getting rebranded to "Nightlight Secrets"!

[img]https://starbitlight.com/posts/sfh-rebranding-img/sfh-to-nls.png[/img]


[h1]Q&A[/h1]
[h2]WHAT DOES THIS CHANGE MEANS?[/h2]
Don't worry, the game is still the same as you remember! All the characters, the story, backstory... will remain (almost) the same. This is mostly nothing more than a "remade from scratch code base in a new game engine that improves the original game with a brand new name".

[h2]WHAT IF I ALREADY PURCHASED "SFH" BEFORE?[/h2]
If you already purchased the game as "SFH", then no worries! The game will simply get updated in your Steam library from "SFH" to "Nightlight Secrets".

[h2]WHY "NIGHTLIGHT SECRETS"?[/h2]
As told, we're very careful about our players feedback. We noticed that the previous name wasn't very appropriated, and it wasn't really reflecting how the game changed over the past years.
Nightlight Secret, the game's new name, reflects the mysterious secrets of the story but also the dreams and nightmares you are able to play as Akai. This new name will also allow us to attract a younger player base too, meaning that the game's rating will be re-ajusted as well.

[h2]WHEN WILL IT RELEASE?[/h2]
It is currently too early to announce when this major update will release. We know you are desperately waiting for a new update since the first release in November 2021, and we are really sorry about the long wait... However, please don't forget that this project is being developed by a really small team on their free time. As of now, you can still get the old "SFH" through Steam, and as said above you will receive the rebranding update as soon as we are ready to release it!


[h1]Conclusion[/h1]
I hope this message will reassure some of you who were doubting that Starbit Light was no longer active and that the game was scrapped. Thank you for your time and your patience.



Feel free to join our Discord server too  ⬇️

notes.title: A teaser of the upcoming update... 🌠
December 9th Patch Update
notes.content:
To ensure the best experience in the game, here's a new patch update! Check out the detailed changelog below if you're interested to see what's new.

[list]
[*] [b]Warning:[/b] To avoid any spoiler on the Act 2 we will not be writing any of our internal changes on it yet. This doesn't mean that progress isn't being made on it. Thank you for understanding...
[*] [b]NEW:[/b] The main menu now shows a description on the slots of where you saved.
[*] [b]NEW:[/b] You can now reset your Steam achievements by pressing [F5] on the main menu.
[*] [b]TWEAKS:[/b] Tweaked the lines in the tutorial dream sequence so it's less long and annoying to just walk around for a really long time.
[*] [b]TWEAKS:[/b] Adjusted Mr. Tori's haircut and height.
[*] [b]TWEAKS:[/b] Adjusted the Act 1 ending cutscene.
[*] [b]BUG-FIX:[/b] While customizing the player in the story mode, pausing the game would make the game completely freeze. As of now, pausing has been disabled in that sequence.
[*] [b]BUG-FIX:[/b] Fixed the Mission Failed screen that was only able to show once when failing a mission.
[*] [b]BUG-FIX:[/b] Fixed some animations that were not looping properly.
[*] [b]TWEAKS:[/b] Removed some debug keys that were accidentally left in some sequences.
[*] [b]TWEAKS:[/b] Upgraded to Unity 2021.2.5f1 to ensure the best stability and performance for the build.
[*] [b]TWEAKS:[/b] Upgraded to Steamworks.NET 20.0.0 to ensure the best stability using the Steam API.
[/list]

notes.title: Wishlist the game now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34829950/c22632863d5b5ffa626da9618eb2764f1145051e.png[/img]

Suicide For Him is getting close to release in early access for the first time on Steam!
You can wishlist the game on Steam, and also join our community to make sure you won't miss the release.
We don't have any proper release date to announce yet, just stay tuned, it can happen at any time 👀

[h2]How is the game going?[/h2]
Why is it taking so long? When is it going to release? Is the game still in development?...

We know that you're wondering a lot about the game, and that you're really excited to play the first early access version, we're as hyped as you are to see all the players reactions!
However, we want to keep things a surprise, it's hard to show anything without spoiling you. Of course, we will make sure to upload a new video trailer for the early access containing actual gameplay footage of how the game has changed so far.

Recently, we worked with some really talented voice actors, we're now implementing their incredible work in-game and animating the characters on top of these lines.
Most of the graphics has been reworked as well, like the character 3D models, the environments, the GUI, and much more. We're putting a lot of detail to our work, we hope you will enjoy them!
We can also guarantee that the game already works perfectly with different control schemes: Mouse and Keyboard, Xbox 360 / One Controller, PS4 / PS5 Controller, and finally Nintendo Switch Pro Controller.

[b]What's missing before releasing the first Early Access version[/b]
Currently, there are some things that needs to be tweaked, optimized and polished in the whole available content. As said above, it's hard to tell anything as that might spoil you... So we will keep you updated whenever we have a proper release date!

Oh, one more thing... We know you want sneak peeks, so here's something for you-
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34829950/fec5f3940f80c2b147228dd35618e70e5e986e66.png[/img]
The quality of this picture is low, this is intentional, you will be able to see every pieces of this picture in the highest quality possible while playing the game~

Thank you so much for following our project, we hope to bring you some fun and entertainment with Suicide For Him!
